title: OralGPT-Omni: A Versatile Dental Multimodal Large Language Model

layout.note: A wide black frame (a) across the top holding eight dashed cards of unequal size, then two pale-pink panels side by side below: (b) wider with the query, steps and response, (c) narrower with a bullet list over a bar chart.

lesson: Number the abstract reasoning steps in a dashed list, highlight each in the colour of its tag in a real response and tie them with grey arrows; pair this with a gallery of dashed modality cards and a sorted bar chart so coverage, example and statistics share one figure.
